title: Three Clues to Find It: Apothecary Diaries Editions, Seasons and Palace Places
description: Ten rounds of three growing clues to name a version of the story (web novel, light novel, manga, anime season), a place in the palace or a doctor. Light spoilers up to season two.
notes: Clues format: three clues of growing help; the clues use studios, years, formats and plot hints from verified facts.

questions.question: Which version of the story is this?
clues: It is the oldest form of the story.
A book from Shufunotomo followed one year after it began.
It began in 2011 on the site Shōsetsuka ni Narō.

questions.question: Which place in the story is this?
clues: It is a pavilion in the Rear Palace.
Hongniang is its head lady-in-waiting.
The emperor's favourite consort lives there.

questions.question: Which season of the anime is this?
clues: Toho Animation Studio and OLM made it together.

Its 24 episodes ended on March 24, 2024.

questions.question: Which version of the story is this?

questions.question: Which place in the story is this?

questions.question: Which season of the anime is this?
